rule: Let A = the 'items' array of enumeration-a.json and B = the 'items' array of the child's enumeration-b.json (both arrays of route strings). Compute U = sort(dedupe(A union B)) by lexicographic string order. Compute F = [{"item": r, "found_only_by": "A"} for each r in A and not in B] concatenated with [{"item": r, "found_only_by": "B"} for each r in B and not in A], sorted by item. Set result.json fields: items := U; flagged := F; method := 'Union of two independent complete enumerations: E-A (exhaustive DFS over simple paths by worker X-E6, see enumeration-a.json) and E-B (independent enumeration by isolated child with no access to E-A, see child deliverable enumeration-b.json); singly-found items flagged in the flagged field.'; complete := true if and only if set(A) == set(B) AND enumeration-b.json field 'complete' == true AND enumeration-a.json field 'complete' == true, else false. Overwrite result.json with these values verbatim. No judgment is required at any step.
